subject: Pen test report request & vulnerability management follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jane Lin <jane.lin@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: pen test report & vuln mgmt (post-demo)

Hi Alex — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and asks from our side so we can move the security review forward: 

1) Compliance posture: can you confirm FintechCo's SOC 2 status (Type I/II and date)? Also let me know if you have any formal HIPAA or other regulatory attestations.

2) Pen test/report: we'd appreciate either a redacted executive summary of your most recent external penetration test or the full report under NDA. The security team will review for any high/critical findings and remediation evidence.

3) Vulnerability management: please confirm your scanning cadence (nmap/credentialed scans/DAST/SCA) and typical SLA for remediation by severity (Critical/High/Medium). Also share your vulnerability disclosure policy — how do you handle coordinated disclosures and public reporting?

4) Vendor security questionnaire: we sent a vendor questionnaire link during the call. Are you able to initiate that now or would you prefer we send over a copy for your security team?

Next steps I propose: if you can share a redacted pen test summary today that would let our security team triage quickly. If full report requires NDA, we can sign — happy to get that started. Can we aim to have a first pass review within 3 business days?

Thanks — looping in our security lead to the thread.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_Link (https://drive.google.com/...)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Lin <jane.lin@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-28T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pen test report & vuln mgmt (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few quick answers and I'm attaching a redacted executive summary now. Full report is available under NDA.

- SOC 2: FintechCo completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) on 2025-09-10. We can share the report and SOC 2 letter.
- HIPAA: We are not a HIPAA-covered entity but we have controls mapped for customers that require PHI handling and can discuss BAA options.
- Pen test: Attached: FintechCo_Redacted_PenTest_2026-02.pdf (executive summary with findings redacted). Full pen test was conducted Feb 2026 by SecureGate.
- Scanning cadence and vuln mgmt: automated SCA/DAST internal scans run weekly; credentialed internal network scans monthly; external black-box scans quarterly; full external pentest annually. SLA for remediation: Critical = 30 days, High = 60 days, Medium = 90 days (exceptions handled case-by-case with compensating controls).
- Disclosure policy: we follow a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy — we work with researchers and customers; public disclosure only after remediation or explicit agreement. See attached FintechCo-VulnDisclosure.pdf.

If you'd like the full report, please sign the mutual NDA here: https://docusign.com/FintechCo/NDA/12345 and we'll push the report within 48 hours of received NDA.

Happy to hop on a quick sync if needed.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Security Operations, FintechCo
alex.rivera@fintechco.com
Attachments: FintechCo_Redacted_PenTest_2026-02.pdf, FintechCo-VulnDisclosure.pdf

Marissa

Thanks for looping me in — I reviewed the redacted executive summary and FintechCo's disclosure doc. Initial notes: 

- Redactions look reasonable for a first-pass triage; I can evaluate high/critical findings as presented, but we'll need the full report under NDA if there are any findings with exploit artifacts or PoCs.
- The stated cadence (weekly SCA/DAST, monthly credentialed scans, quarterly external scans, annual pentest) aligns with our expectations for a production SaaS vendor.
- SLA targets (Critical 30d / High 60d / Medium 90d) are acceptable; we may request evidence of time-to-fix for past findings if there are any repeat issues.
- Disclosure: coordinated disclosure policy is good; confirm whether they have a security@ email for researcher intake and triage (FintechCo-VulnDisclosure.pdf references it but I want the exact address).

Action items:
- Marissa: If Alex can route the NDA DocuSign to me (or sign mutual NDA), I'll accept and Rishi's team can review the full report within 48 hours.
- Vivek: please review the redacted report for any product-specific implications (APIs, rate limits) and flag anything that would affect our deployment guidance.

I'll prepare a short internal summary (exec bullet list) once I have the full report or if the redactions include detailed severity context. Target: 3 business days for a full internal assessment provided we receive the full report under NDA.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
